title: SUNRISE POLICE DEPARTMENT
key_finding: The City says Sunrise Police Department is a Florida-accredited law-enforcement agency and that the City's Public Safety Building is the department's headquarters and contains the City's 9-1-1 Dispatch Center.

title: Office of The Chief
key_finding: The City identifies Daniel J. Ransone as Chief of the Sunrise Police Department and says he assumed chief responsibilities in June 2023.

title: Message From the Chief
key_finding: The Chief's message page says the department had 323 professional employees as of June 2023, including 219 sworn officers and 104 civilian employees.

title: Sunrise Police History
key_finding: The City's police-history page says the City of Sunrise Golf Village Police Department was established in 1961.

title: Police Records
key_finding: The Records Unit page says the unit maintains crime reports and statistical records and provides police-report access from the Sunrise Public Safety Building.

title: BSO On Call
key_finding: BSO's public On Call page lists law-enforcement service areas including Cooper City, Deerfield Beach, Lauderdale Lakes, Pembroke Park, Weston, and the Broward Municipal Services District; Sunrise is not listed.

title: County and Municipal Offense Report 2020A
key_finding: FDLE's 2020 county-and-municipal offense report lists Sunrise Police Department with population 94,333 and total index crime 1,519.

title: County and Municipal Offense Report 2021A
key_finding: FDLE's 2021 county-and-municipal offense report lists Sunrise Police Department as a municipal row with a partial-year indicator, 120 days, population 97,359, and total index crime 507.

title: FIBRS Offense Detail 2021-2025 Q3 workbook
key_finding: Inspection of the official FDLE FIBRS offense workbook found no Sunrise Police Department row in the 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, or 2025 Q3 sheets.

title: agency_to_jurisdiction_crosswalk.parquet
key_finding: The live crosswalk routes FL0062700 exclusively to Sunrise city.

title: agency_master.parquet
key_finding: FL0062700 is classified as a local police department and is flagged with SRS and NIBRS years through 2024, even though nibrs_max_months_reported is 0.0.

title: agency_year_observations.parquet
key_finding: FL0062700 currently has CIUS local rows in 2018 and 2019, a nonzero 2020 SRS annual row, and zero-valued SRS rows for every tracked offense from 2021 through 2024.

title: jurisdiction_controls_2024.parquet
key_finding: All 2024 Sunrise offense controls are fully filled because preferred reported support is zero and the row is treated as structurally missing or unreliable.

title: municipal_target_review_queue.parquet
key_finding: Sunrise is queued in high_impact_full_fill_place with total_fill_count 2202.0 and zero reported support.
